Nagabhushana YR							         nagabhushanayr@gmail.com

+91 - 9986277260                		                              https://www.linkedin.com/in/nagabhushana-yr/

Role:                                  Engineering Manager & Architect – DevOps & Cloud

Company: 		   Siemens Healthineers

Total IT Experience: 	   18 years

DevOps & Cloud Exp:     10 Years

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-oriented DevOps Architect & Engineering Manager with 18 years of IT experience, including 10 years in Cloud and DevOps.

Proven expertise in designing enterprise-scale cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and automation frameworks.

Skilled in leading and mentoring cross-functional teams of 8–10 engineers, defining DevOps strategies, and driving modernization across multi-cloud environments (AWS & Azure).

Strong background in technical leadership, cost optimization, and security governance, ensuring high availability, scalability, and compliance of mission-critical systems

                                                               CORE COMPETENCIES

Area Key Technologies and Expertise Cloud Architecture AWS (EKS, VPC, RDS, NLB, Transit Gateway, Route53, SecurityGroups, TGW,S3), Azure (AKS, AD, Traffic Manager, Key Vault), Multi-Cloud Container & Orchestration Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, Rancher, Calico Enterprise, GitOps (FluxCD / ArgoCD), Karpenter CI/CD , Scripting & Toolchain GitLab , Azure DevOps, Jfrog Artifactory, Bash/Shell Scripting, RabbitMQ, Nginx. Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform). Observability & Security Prometheus, Grafana, OpenSearch / ELK Stack, Splunk, Mend.io, Clair, KubeBench (CIS Benchmark), SonarQube, Veracode. Leadership & Process Team Leadership, Technical Strategy & Roadmap Definition, Cost Optimization, Incident/Escalation Management, Stakeholder Engagement, Mentoring & Coaching

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Siemens Healthineers, Bangalore                                                                                                May 2021  - till date Engineering Manager and Architect – DevOps & Cloud

Defined and executed the DevOps strategy and roadmap for multiple business units, accelerating cloud adoption and automation maturity.

Led a team of 8+ engineers, improving delivery speed and operational reliability through CI/CD automation and IaC.

Architected and deployed enterprise-grade Kubernetes platforms (EKS) for high-availability, multi-region systems.

Championed initiatives like GitLab → Azure DevOps migration, Calico Enterprise adoption, and multi-cluster strategy.

Drove cost optimization saving $200K+ annually by implementing efficient cloud design , avoiding cross AZ traffic, config auto scaler configuration, implementing karpenter etc.

Lead capacity planning, disaster recovery and failover strategies to ensure business continuity.

Partnered with product and security teams to integrate DevSecOps best practices (CIS Benchmark, Clair, threat modeling).

Acted as key member of Architecture Review Board, influencing tool and design decisions suitable to application and infrastructure.

Developed monitoring dashboards using Prometheus and Grafana to track monitor infrastructure u and set up alerts to MS teams using alertmanager.

Tools and Technologies: AWS, Azure DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitLab, Helm, Prometheus, Grafana, JFrog, Calico, NGINX, Sonarqube, checkmarx, keycloak, cert-manager

Tata Consultancy Services ,   India, Uruguay & USA                                                             July 2014  -  May 2021 Lead DevOps Engineer

Managed DevOps delivery and major incident operations for multiple global clients.

Designed and maintained Azure and Kubernetes-based container platforms, integrating CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps.

Automated builds, deployments and environment provisioning using Terraform.

Drove containerization and migration of legacy systems to microservices on Kubernetes.

Coordinated across global teams for escalation handling, migrations, and production support.

Tools and Technologies: Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Jenkins, Git, SonarQube, ELK, Python

IMS Health India Pvt Ltd, Bangalore                                                                                             Oct 2012 – Jul 2013 Senior Software Engineer

Worked on .NET-based enterprise applications and SQL Server BI components (SSIS/SSRS/WCF)

Wipro Technologies, Bangalore                                                                                                    Jul 2011 – Sep 2012 Senior Software Engineer

Developed and maintained .NET applications across multiple business domains

Infosys Technologies, Bangalore                                                                                                  Apr 2008 - July 2011 Software Engineer

Contributed to ASP.NET and SQL Server projects with focus on performance optimization and maintenance

Interplex Electronics India pvt ltd, Bangalore                                                                            Jun 2006 - Mar 2008 Quality Engineer

EDUCATION:

Bachelor of Engineering (Mechanical Engineering)
Siddaganga Institute of Technology, Tumkur – VTU, Karnataka | 2002-2006 | 75.5%

Current Address:

571, 14th Cross, 3rd block, Vishwapriya Layout, Begur road,

Bangalore – 560068 , Karnataka
